verdict.rationale: Column is an API-first bank, so API versioning and deprecation policy is a fair question for it. However, no evidence item mentions API versions, version headers, changelogs, or a deprecation policy. The OpenAPI spec and idempotency docs are adjacent API-quality features and do not show versioning or deprecation commitments.
